test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

Stoic thought
P. through rational detachment
Q. over desire
R. and inner control
S. advocates endurance
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (2)** i.e. **SQPR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with "Stoic thought advocates endurance," which is correctly indicated by **part (S).**
 
• Following this, "through rational detachment" **(Q)** logically connects to the advocacy of endurance, explaining how it is achieved.
 
• **The next part,** "over desire," **(P)** builds on the idea of detachment by contrasting it with a negative concept that Stoic thought seeks to overcome.
 
• **Ending with** "and inner control" **(R)** completes the sentence by emphasizing the goal of inner strength and mastery.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option (2) SQPR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (RSQP):** This option starts with "and inner control through rational detachment," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence, as it introduces the conclusion before the reasoning.
 
• **Option 3 (PSQR):** This option begins with "over desire Stoic thought advocates endurance," which is grammatically and contextually incorrect, as it places the contrast before introducing the main subject.
 
• **Option 4 (QPSR):** This option starts with "through rational detachment over desire," which omits the subject and creates an incomplete and confusing sentence structure.
